body:
Findings of the protocol and server-interface review after T-315 (three reviewers, all verified by
request or test). Fix in one pass across server, web and Android.

## Server, P2

1. **A lone UTF-16 surrogate in any JSON string answers an HTML 500** (`"\ud800"` is legal JSON;
   Python keeps it and SQLite/encode fail). On `/sync` the whole push gets a 500 with no `row_id`,
   so the client cannot quarantine the row and its push queue is stuck; on the partial admin PUT
   the registration override was already committed when the message write failed. Fix: reject
   unpaired surrogates (a) per string field in the sync row parser with `422 invalid_field` +
   `row_id`/`field`, (b) in `validate_message` as `invalid_message`, and (c) as a fallback in
   `json_body()` by trying to encode the decoded body — `422 invalid_request`. Contract: one
   sentence that strings must be valid Unicode scalar values. Tests for each.
2. **Deeply nested JSON answers 500 unauthenticated**: `json_body()` swallows ValueError but not
   RecursionError (a 100 KB body of 50 000 `[`). Catch it → `422 invalid_request`. Test.
3. **Unknown or wrong-method paths under `/api/v1/` return the web app with 200** (the SPA
   catch-all), and an HTML 405 without the security headers. Fix: a JSON `404 not_found` for any
   unmatched path under the API prefix and a JSON `405 method_not_allowed`, both with the usual
   headers, scoped to the blueprint (T-250). Error table rows; both clients' error tables get the
   two codes with the sentence "The server does not know this request." (identical English). The
   contract's sentence about `/api/v1/*` ranking above the catch-all becomes true.
4. **The partial `PUT /admin/server-settings` commits twice**: one transaction, commit at the end,
   so a `503 server_busy` really means nothing was applied.
5. **The message rule is pinned by a shared table**, `shared-test-cases/server-message.json`
   (already on main; this ticket wires it). Rule: trim the characters U+0009, U+000A, U+000D,
   U+0020 and every Zs from both ends; then refuse (`invalid_message`) any Cc, Zl (U+2028), Zp
   (U+2029), the bidi embeddings/overrides U+202A–U+202E, and any unpaired surrogate; count the
   remaining code points, more than 200 is refused; if nothing but Cf and Zs remains the message
   is empty (cleared, `null`). Isolates U+2066–2069, ZWJ/ZWNJ, RLM/LRM and links-as-text stay
   allowed. Server, web and Android implement exactly this and each reads the table in a test.
   Contract: state the rule.
6. **A 500 answers with Flask's HTML page**: a blueprint-scoped InternalServerError handler that
   returns the JSON envelope `{"error": "internal_error", "message": …}` without details; error
   table row; both clients map it to the generic sentence.
7. **`GET /lists/{id}/members` includes expired invites** while `/invites/pending` excludes them:
   exclude them from `members` too and say so in the contract.

## Docs, P3

8. `docs/wire-contract.md`: the input caps count characters (code points), not bytes; the
   `not_a_member` error row also lists `POST /lists/{id}/invites`, `DELETE /invites/{id}` and
   `POST /lists/{id}/leave`; a non-boolean `allow_registration` is `422 invalid_request`; the
   protocol header is at most 9 digits (T-248) — say so in the "Protocol version" section.

## Clients

9. **Android**: `UpdateSettingsRequest.defaultCurrency` becomes `String? = null` and
   `AccountViewModel.updateInitials` sends only `initials` (today it re-sends the cached
   currency and can revert a change made on another device; the web omits it since T-272).
   DtoTest asserts the body is `{"initials":"XY"}`.
10. **Web**: `encodeURIComponent` on every id interpolated into a path in `web/src/api/client.ts`
    (lists, invites, sessions, admin users); `Session.device_label` typed `string | null`.
11. **Admin message controls, both clients the same**: Save then Clear; Save disabled while the
    text equals the stored one, Clear disabled while nothing is stored (Android already; web
    adopts it).
12. Both clients: the message pre-check implements rule 5 via the shared table; the two new error
    codes and `internal_error` in the error tables.
title: Protocol review follow-ups: lone surrogates and deep JSON answer 500, API 404 is the SPA, the message rule pinned by a shared table, initials save reverts the currency, docs
